subject: english
question:
Select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of idiom/phrases.

A white elephant

options.text: A useless possession which is extremely expensive to keep
Someone belonging to a royal family

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. A useless possession which is extremely expensive to keep.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"A white elephant"** refers to something that is costly to maintain but has little practical use. (बेकार और महंगा वस्तु)

 
 
• **Example:** The old palace turned out to be a white elephant for the new owners, as its upkeep was draining their finances.
 
 
 
• **Explanation:** Historically, the term originates from Siam (modern-day Thailand), where white elephants were considered sacred but were costly to maintain. (ऐतिहासिक रूप से, यह शब्द थाईलैंड से आया है।)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e., A useless possession which is extremely expensive to keep.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: An extinct species** (लुप्त प्रजाति)

 
 
• **Meaning:** Refers to species that no longer exist, like dinosaurs.
 
• **Example:** The Dodo is an example of an extinct species.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Someone belonging to a royal family** (राजघराने का व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Meaning:** Refers to individuals who are part of a monarchy or royal lineage.
 
• **Example:** Prince Charles belongs to the British royal family.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: An endangered species** (संकटग्रस्त प्रजाति)
 
 
• **Meaning:** Refers to species that are at risk of extinction due to various factors.
 
• **Example:** Pandas are considered an endangered species.
 
 

35:Te9c,
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
